title: LifeReplay segment metadata (iPhone upload)
description: Sent base64-encoded in the X-LifeReplay-Metadata header with each segment upload. Mirrors IngestSegmentMetadata (C#) and SegmentMetadata (Swift). Unknown fields are ignored by the server.

sessionId.description: One broadcast from start to stop.

deviceId.description: Random per-install id stored in the App Group, not a hardware id.

startUtcMs.description: Wall-clock time of the first frame, UTC Unix ms.

endUtcMs.description: End of the segment, UTC Unix ms. Must be after start and at most 2 hours later.

endReason.description: interrupted = the extension was terminated and the file was trimmed to its last complete fragment.
